# `omapac aur diff`

- **Usage:** `omapac aur diff [--commit <COMMIT>] <PACKAGE>`

Show the PKGBUILD diff since the approved commit

## Arguments
- **`<PACKAGE>`** — The package name

## Flags
- **`--commit <COMMIT>`** — Diff to this commit instead of the current one
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
